material.locator: ILO Practical Guide (June 2026), printed pp. 22–27 (migration and mobility concepts, definitions, stocks and flows); pp. 34–38 (international labour migration and labour attachment).
material.description: Supports the need to define and distinguish international labour migration and temporary labour mobility and to operationalize relevant concepts, stocks and flows when compiling labour-migration statistics. It does not determine an individual's legal immigration status or replace the UNSD general migration-statistics recommendations.
